intro: Princess Must Die! is a local bounty offered by Ma Stonefield at the Stonefield Farm in southern Elwynn Forest. She seeks an end to Princess, an enormous prize-winning sow from the nearby Brackwell Pumpkin Patch that continually raids her prized vegetable patches. Putting down the rampaging pig ensures the Stonefields can harvest their crops in peace.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Brackwells have a prize-winning pig, Princess. The sow is HUGE, and she got that way from sneaking over here and eating my veggies!
So before she comes to our fields...Princess must die! Bring me her collar as proof of the deed and I'll give you something for your time!
Princess is usually over at the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch, to the east and beyond the Maclure farm. Get her before she gets hungry and comes back here!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did you see her yet? Did you get her?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank goodness! That pig was getting so big she'd have eaten our whole crop! Thank you, friend.
Now, do either of these suit you?
